WITH 
	params as (
		select
			-10 as days_interval,
			20 as allowed_deviation_pct
	),
	business_dates_range as (
		select
			max(publish_timestamp) as latest_publish_timestamp,
			max(business_date) as end_date,
			date_add('day', 
					(select days_interval from params), 
					max(business_date)) as start_date
		from
			credit_investment_private_enriched_dev.ci_capital_pipeline
	),
	record_counts as (
		select
			publish_timestamp,
			business_date,
			count(*) as number_of_recs
		from 
			credit_investment_private_enriched_dev.ci_capital_pipeline
			join business_dates_range
				on business_date 
					between start_date 
					and end_date
		group by
			publish_timestamp,
			business_date
	),
	rec_count_daily_chg_limits as (
		select
			avg(number_of_recs)
				-avg(number_of_recs)*(select allowed_deviation_pct from params)/100.0 as daily_min_rec_number,
			avg(number_of_recs)
				+avg(number_of_recs)*(select allowed_deviation_pct from params)/100.0 as daily_max_rec_number
		from 
			record_counts
			join business_dates_range
				on business_date >= start_date 
					and business_date <= end_date
	)
select 
    case when number_of_recs < daily_min_rec_number
                or number_of_recs > daily_max_rec_number
        then 1 
        else 0 
        end as is_out_of_bounds
from 
    record_counts
    cross join rec_count_daily_chg_limits
    join business_dates_range on
        business_date = end_date
        and publish_timestamp = latest_publish_timestamp

		SELECT

			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 08 and 09
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 08:46:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

with hedge_ratio_src as (
	select case
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap'
			and cast(date(dpi.maturity_date) as varchar) = dpi.business_date
			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0 then f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap'
			and cast(date(dpi.maturity_date) as varchar) = dpi.business_date
			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy != 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap' then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy + f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Convertible Bond'
			and f.abacus_pv_base_ccy = 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Convertible Bond'
			and f.abacus_pv_base_ccy != 0 then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy else f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
		end hedge_pv,
		coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * coalesce(dpi.local_currency_fcp, 0) as fcp_base,
		dpi.long_short,
		h.dim_hierarchy_node_id
	from risk_uat.dim_pos_inst dpi
		join risk_uat.fact_pos_calc_sd f on f.pos_id = dpi.pos_id
		and dpi.business_date = f.business_date
		join risk_uat.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk h on h.dim_hierarchy_node_id = f.dim_hierarchy_node_id
		and dpi.business_date = h.business_date
		left join risk_uat.fact_fx_rate fx ON dpi.local_currency_iso_code = fx.to_currency
		and fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
		and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'
		and dpi.business_date = fx.business_date
	where dpi.business_date = '2025-05-30'
		and dpi.portfolio_Type = 'IP'
		and (
			dpi.maturity_date is null
			or to_date(dpi.business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= dpi.maturity_date
		)
		 AND  h.investment_strat in ('AE Enhanced Beta')
		 and not (  dpi.security_group_name in ('Call Money Funding Services', 'Cash Bucket', 'Cost', 'Internal Funding Source and Loans', 'FX Non Deliverable Forward'))
),
hedge_ratio_short_long as (
	select sum(
			case
				when long_short = 'LONG' then hedge_pv else 0
			end
		) as long_hedge_pv,
		sum(
			case
				when long_short = 'SHORT' then hedge_pv else 0
			end
		) as short_hedge_pv,
		sum(fcp_base) fcp_base_pv,
		'Y' subtruct_fcp
	from hedge_ratio_src a
)
select 'AE_BETA_SMD_LOW_HEDGERATIO_PCT_B' as LIMIT_NAME,
	case
		when subtruct_fcp = 'Y' then coalesce(abs((short_hedge_pv - fcp_base_pv) / long_hedge_pv), 0) * 100
		when subtruct_fcp = 'N' then coalesce(abs(short_hedge_pv / long_hedge_pv), 0) * 100
	end as MEASURE_VALUE
  from hedge_ratio_short_long a

SELECT

  base.abor_security_name,
  base.dirty_value_total_pc,
  COALESCE(lt.total_lookthrough_value_pc, 0) AS total_lookthrough_value_pc,

FROM (
  SELECT
    mh.scd_holding_key_id,
    mh.abor_security_type_name,
    mh.abor_security_name,
    SUM(mh.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency) AS dirty_value_total_pc

  WHERE
    mh.portfolio_group_id IN ('ACPP', 'BCPP', 'CPPIB GROUP', 'SUPPLEMENTARY')
    AND mh.business_date = '2025-05-31'
  GROUP BY
    mh.scd_holding_key_id,
    mh.abor_security_type_name,
    mh.abor_security_name
) base
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    lt.parent_holding_key,
    SUM(lt.total_market_value_pc) AS total_lookthrough_value_pc
  FROM
    holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough lt
  WHERE
    lt.business_date = DATE('2025-05-31')
  GROUP BY
    lt.parent_holding_key
) lt
  ON base.scd_holding_key_id = lt.parent_holding_key
ORDER BY
  ABS(base.dirty_value_total_pc - COALESCE(lt.total_lookthrough_value_pc, 0)) DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor

SELECT
	from_currency
	,to_currency
	,mid_price
	,business_date
	,inverse_quoted
FROM
(
	SELECT
		from_currency
		,to_currency
		,CASE
			WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1/mid_price
			ELSE mid_price
		END as mid_price
		,business_date
		,'N' as inverse_quoted
	FROM
		"market"."refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr"
	WHERE
		(
			(rate_type_code ='SR'
			AND from_currency ='USD'
			AND to_currency IN ('AED','ARS','AUD','BMD','BRL','BSD','CAD','CHF','CLP','CNH','CNY','COP','CZK','DKK','EGP','EUR','GBP','GHS','HKD','HRK','HUF','IDR','ILS','INR','JPY','KRW','KYD','MAD','MXN','MYR','NGN','NOK','NZD','PAB','PEN','PHP','PLN','RON','RUB','SEK','SGD','THB','TRY','TWD','UAH','VND','ZAR')
		)
		OR
			(rate_type_code ='SR'
			AND from_currency ='GBP'
			AND to_currency IN ('EUR'))
		)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		t_usdrates.to_currency as from_currency
		,t_usdcadrate.to_currency
		,t_usdcadrate.mid_price/t_usdrates.mid_price as mid_price
		,t_usdcadrate.business_date
		,t_usdcadrate.inverse_quoted
	FROM
	(
		SELECT
			from_currency
			,to_currency
			,CASE
				WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1/mid_price
				ELSE mid_price
			END as mid_price
			,business_date
			,'N' as inverse_quoted
		FROM
			"market"."refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr"
		WHERE
			rate_type_code = 'SR'
			AND from_currency = 'USD'
			AND to_currency = 'CAD'
	) t_usdcadrate
	INNER JOIN
	(
		SELECT
			from_currency
			,to_currency
			,CASE
				WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1/mid_price
				ELSE mid_price
			END as mid_price
			,business_date
			,'N' as inverse_quoted
		FROM
			"market"."refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr"
		WHERE
			rate_type_code ='SR'
			AND from_currency ='USD'
			AND to_currency IN ('AED','ARS','AUD','BMD','BRL','BSD','CHF','CLP','CNH','CNY','COP','CZK','DKK','EGP','EUR','GBP','GHS','HKD','HRK','HUF','IDR','ILS','INR','JPY','KRW','KYD','MAD','MXN','MYR','NGN','NOK','NZD','PAB','PEN','PHP','PLN','RON','RUB','SEK','SGD','THB','TRY','TWD','UAH','VND','ZAR')
	) t_usdrates
	ON t_usdrates.business_date = t_usdcadrate.business_date
	AND t_usdrates.from_currency = t_usdcadrate.from_currency
) t_rates
WHERE business_date BETWEEN date('2025-06-02') AND date('2025-06-02')

WITH 
params as (
    select
        -10 as days_interval,
        20 as allowed_deviation_pct
),
business_dates_range as (
    select
        max(publish_timestamp) as latest_publish_timestamp,
        max(business_date) as end_date,
        date_add('day', (select days_interval from params) , max(business_date)) as start_date
    from
        credit_investment_private_enriched_dev.ci_capital_pipeline
),
record_counts as (
    select
        publish_timestamp,
        business_date,
        count(*) as number_of_recs
    from 
        credit_investment_private_enriched_dev.ci_capital_pipeline
        join business_dates_range
            on business_date between start_date and end_date
    group by
        publish_timestamp,
        business_date
),
rec_count_chg_limits as (
    select
        avg(number_of_recs)-avg(number_of_recs)*0.2 as daily_min_rec_number,
        avg(number_of_recs)+avg(number_of_recs)*0.2 as daily_max_rec_number
    from 
        record_counts
        join business_dates_range
            on business_date >= start_date 
                and business_date <= end_date
)

select 
    case when number_of_recs < daily_min_rec_number
                or number_of_recs > daily_max_rec_number
        then 1 
        else 0 
        end as is_out_of_bounds
from 
    record_counts
    cross join rec_count_chg_limits
    join business_dates_range on
        business_date = end_date
        and publish_timestamp = latest_publish_timestamp

		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc

			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc

			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), asset_class_clean as (
	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		asset_class_base
	where
		business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		/*and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD', '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) )
		and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) )*/
)
select * from asset_class_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_asset_class"

SELECT "data_date", "vendor", "currency", "exchange_rate", "is_exchange_holiday_flag", "year_month", "base_currency"
FROM (WITH original_data AS (
    SELECT 
        data_date, 
        vendor, 
        currency, 
        exchange_rate, 
        is_exchange_holiday_flag, 
        year_month,
        'CAD' AS base_currency
    FROM 
        market.cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad
    WHERE vendor = 'wm'
),
inverse_data AS (
    SELECT 
        data_date, 
        vendor, 
        'CAD' AS currency, 
        1 / exchange_rate AS exchange_rate, 
        is_exchange_holiday_flag, 
        year_month,
        currency AS base_currency
    FROM 
        market.cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad
    WHERE vendor = 'wm'
)
SELECT * FROM original_data
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM inverse_data
WHERE NOT (currency = 'CAD' AND base_currency = 'CAD')) AS "New custom SQL"

    stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency
from (
    select *,
    row_number() over (partition by scd_transaction_number_primary_key order by business_date desc) as rn
    from trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
    where transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
) st
left join (
    select *,
    row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
    from asset.enterprise_security
) es
    on st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
    and es.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
    on smp.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio )
    and st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join (
    select *,
    row_number() over (partition by scd_party_id order by business_date desc) as rn
    from party.enterprise_party
) ep
    on st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id
    and ep.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_securities ss
    on st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
    and ss.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities )
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
    on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
    and rec.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes )
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country
    on es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
    and rcc_exchange_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
    on es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
    and rcc_incorp_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join (
    select *, 
    row_number() over(partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
    from reference.scd_portfolio
    )sp
    on sp.latest = 1
    and sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
    on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
    and rcc_trade_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join (
    select abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
        sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
        max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
        sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
        sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
        sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
        sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
        sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
        sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
        sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_settlement_currency
    from trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
    group by abor_transaction_number,
        business_date,
        transaction_cancellation_flag,
        trade_date
    ) stc
    on st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
    and st.business_date = stc.business_date
    and st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
    and st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
left join reference.reference_currency_codes rcc
    on st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
    and rcc.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_currency_codes )
where st.rn = 1
and st.business_date='2025-04-01'

				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name

		, parent_quoted_currency_code
		, parent_quoted_currency_name
		, currency_of_exposure_code
		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EU'
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end country_of_exposure_code
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EUROPEAN UNION'
			else country_of_exposure_name

		, country_of_exposure_name as country_of_exposure_name_original

		, parent_security_name

		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'COUNTRY'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then 'CURRENCY'
			else 'COUNTRY'

			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code

			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then currency_of_exposure_code

		, regexp_replace( coalesce( mapping.external_reporting_country, mapping.lkp_nme ), '(\w)(\w*)', x -> upper(x[1]) || lower(x[2])) as external_reporting_country
	from
		lt_lkp
	left join
		mapping
			on lt_lkp.lkp_value = mapping.lkp_value

	select
		  lt_map.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'China', 'Hong Kong', 'Taiwan', 'Macao' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'India' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case
			when currency_of_exposure_code in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
	from
		lt_map

	select *
	from (
		select

			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name

		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case

			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EU'
			else country_of_exposure_code

		, case

			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null

		, case

			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then 'CURRENCY'

			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'

			else 'COUNTRY'

			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code

			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then currency_of_exposure_code

	from
		lt_lkp

	select

		, case

			when external_reporting_country = 'India' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'

		, case

			else 'Other'

		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region

		from (

				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country

				, external_reporting_dm_em_region

				, year_month
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc

				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from

			group by

				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0

		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name

		, case

			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code

			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then parent_quoted_currency_code

	from

			when external_reporting_country = 'India' then 'India'

				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from

			group by

				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name
), lt_clean as (
	select
		  business_date
		, id_model_portfolio
		, pool_name
		, security_name
		, total_market_value_pc
		, bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, parent_quoted_currency_code
		, parent_quoted_currency_name
		, currency_of_exposure_code
		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EU'
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end country_of_exposure_code
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EUROPEAN UNION'
			else country_of_exposure_name
		  end country_of_exposure_name
		, country_of_exposure_code as country_of_exposure_code_original
		, country_of_exposure_name as country_of_exposure_name_original
		, leg_no

		, parent_security_name

		, investment_structure_level_02
	from
		lt_base
	where
		id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
), lt_lkp as (
	select
		  lt_clean.*
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'COUNTRY'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then 'CURRENCY'
			else 'COUNTRY'
		  end lkp_typ
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'CA'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then parent_quoted_currency_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then currency_of_exposure_code
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end lkp_value
	from 
		lt_clean

	select
		  lt_lkp.*
		, mapping.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mapping.external_reporting_region
		, regexp_replace( coalesce( mapping.external_reporting_country, mapping.lkp_nme ), '(\w)(\w*)', x -> upper(x[1]) || lower(x[2])) as external_reporting_country
	from
		lt_lkp
	left join
		mapping
			on lt_lkp.lkp_value = mapping.lkp_value

	select
		  lt_map.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'China', 'Hong Kong', 'Taiwan', 'Macao' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'India' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case
			when currency_of_exposure_code in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency

		lt_map

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name
), lt_clean as (
	select
		  business_date
		, id_model_portfolio
		, pool_name
		, security_name
		, total_market_value_pc
		, bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, parent_quoted_currency_code
		, parent_quoted_currency_name
		, currency_of_exposure_code
		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EU'
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end country_of_exposure_code
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EUROPEAN UNION'
			else country_of_exposure_name
		  end country_of_exposure_name
		, country_of_exposure_code as country_of_exposure_code_original
		, country_of_exposure_name as country_of_exposure_name_original
		, leg_no
		, parent_security_number
		, parent_security_name
		, parent_security_type_name
		, parent_instrument_type_id
		, investment_structure_level_01
		, investment_structure_level_02
	from
		lt_base
	where
		id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
), lt_lkp as (
	select
		  lt_clean.*
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'COUNTRY'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then 'CURRENCY'
			else 'COUNTRY'
		  end lkp_typ
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'CA'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then parent_quoted_currency_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then currency_of_exposure_code
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end lkp_value
	from 
		lt_clean
), lt_map as (
	select
		  lt_lkp.*
		, mapping.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mapping.external_reporting_region
		, regexp_replace( coalesce( mapping.external_reporting_country, mapping.lkp_nme ), '(\w)(\w*)', x -> upper(x[1]) || lower(x[2])) as external_reporting_country
	from
		lt_lkp
	left join
		mapping

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name
), lt_clean as (
	select

		, id_model_portfolio
		, pool_name
		, security_name
		, total_market_value_pc
		, bcpp_total_market_value_pc

		, parent_quoted_currency_code
		, parent_quoted_currency_name
		, currency_of_exposure_code
		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EU'
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end country_of_exposure_code
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EUROPEAN UNION'
			else country_of_exposure_name
		  end country_of_exposure_name

		lt_base
	where

	select
		  lt_clean.*
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'COUNTRY'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then 'CURRENCY'
			else 'COUNTRY'
		  end lkp_typ
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'CA'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then parent_quoted_currency_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then currency_of_exposure_code

	select

	from
		lt_lkp
	left join
		mapping
			on lt_lkp.lkp_value = mapping.lkp_value
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_map.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'China', 'Hong Kong', 'Taiwan', 'Macao' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'India' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case
			when currency_of_exposure_code in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
	from
		lt_map
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency

			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region

			from

), lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.leg_no
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.parent_security_name
		, ss.abor_security_type_name as parent_security_type_name
		, ss.abor_instrument_type_id as parent_instrument_type_id
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO REFERENCE DATA */
	left join 
		reference.scd_securities ss
			on mhl.business_date = cast( ss.business_date as date )
			and mhl.parent_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name = unitization.pool_name

	select

		, pool_name

		, total_market_value_pc
		, bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, parent_quoted_currency_code
		, parent_quoted_currency_name
		, currency_of_exposure_code
		, currency_of_exposure_name
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EU'
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end country_of_exposure_code
		, case
			when upper(country_of_exposure_name) in ( 'NOT APPLICABLE', 'NOT AVAILABLE', 'DEVELOPED OTHER' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_code in ( 'X0' ) then null
			when country_of_exposure_name = 'EUROPE (EX UK)' then 'EUROPEAN UNION'
			else country_of_exposure_name
		  end country_of_exposure_name
		, country_of_exposure_code as country_of_exposure_code_original
		, country_of_exposure_name as country_of_exposure_name_original
		, leg_no
		, parent_security_number
		, parent_security_name

		, parent_instrument_type_id

	select
		  lt_clean.*
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'COUNTRY'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then 'CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then 'QUOTED CURRENCY'
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then 'CURRENCY'
			else 'COUNTRY'
		  end lkp_typ
		, case
			when parent_security_type_name in ( 'Medium term debt', 'Internal Term Debt Issuance', 'IRS Interest Rate' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'Securities lending', 'Call money', 'Deposit', 'Cash bucket', 'CD', 'CP' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when parent_instrument_type_id in ( 'FX Forward' ) then 'CA'
			when leg_no = 2 and parent_security_type_name in ( 'Options-OTC-Credit', 'TRS Equity IC', 'TRS Fixed Income IC', 'Options-OTC-Equity' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null and currency_of_exposure_code is null then parent_quoted_currency_code
			when country_of_exposure_code is null then currency_of_exposure_code
			else country_of_exposure_code
		  end lkp_value
	from 
		lt_clean

	select
		  lt_lkp.*
		, mapping.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mapping.external_reporting_region
		, regexp_replace( coalesce( mapping.external_reporting_country, mapping.lkp_nme ), '(\w)(\w*)', x -> upper(x[1]) || lower(x[2])) as external_reporting_country
	from
		lt_lkp
	left join
		mapping
			on lt_lkp.lkp_value = mapping.lkp_value
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_map.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'China', 'Hong Kong', 'Taiwan', 'Macao' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'India' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case
			when currency_of_exposure_code in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then currency_of_exposure_code
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
	from
		lt_map
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, business_date_string
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, year_month
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0

select distinct 
	'trs_trades' as table_name, 
	underlying_instrument_name as instrument_name,
	trade_id as id_parent_position,
	id_instrument,
	m.id_model_portfolio,
	market_value,
	fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
	(case returnleg_leg_type 
		when 'paying' then -1
			else 1 
		END 
		* current_price *
		case current_quantity 
		when null then 0
			else current_quantity
		END
	) as pv,
	current_quantity as quantity,
	current_price as current_price,
	'' as current_price_currency,
	0 as variation_margin,
	'' as quoted_currency_code,
	'' as unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
	cast(final_fixing_date as varchar) as final_fixing_date,
	returnleg_leg_type as returnleg_leg_type,
	returnleg_original_currency as returnleg_original_currency,
	(case returnleg_leg_type 
		when 'paying' then -1
			else 1 
		END 
		* current_price *
		case current_quantity 
		when null then 0
			else current_quantity
		END
	)
	 as pv_fx,
	current_notional as current_notional,
	interestleg_original_currency as interestleg_original_currency ,
	interestleg_value as interestleg_value,
	future_cash_flows as future_cash_flows,
	interestleg_leg_type as interestleg_leg_type,
	fx_rate_base_currency as fx_rate_base_currency,
	cast(trade_date as varchar) as trade_date,
	cast(null as double) as current_nominal,
    cast(null as double) as current_nominal_pc,
	(case returnleg_leg_type 
		-- logically return leg exposure is current_quantity * current_price * spot fx_rate_int_leg_ret_leg
		-- but fx_rate_int_leg_ret_leg is a snapshot value not the daily spot rate, therefore working backwards from returnleg_value
		when 'paying' then (current_notional - (returnleg_value - future_cash_flows)) * -1
			else current_notional + (returnleg_value - future_cash_flows)
		END 
	) as clean_market_value,
	(case returnleg_leg_type 
		when 'paying' then (current_notional - (returnleg_value - future_cash_flows)) * -1
			else (current_notional + (returnleg_value - future_cash_flows))
		END 
		* fx_rate_quoted_in_cad
	) as clean_market_value_pc,
	cast(null as double) as current_quantity,
	'' as instrument_lot_size,
	cast(null as double) as underlying_instrument_price,
	'' as instrument_type,
	'' as instrument_family_name_source,
	'' as instrument_group_name_source,
	'' as instrument_sub_type,
	'' as 	current_contract_id
from trades_deals.trs_trades t  
left join finance_accounting.murex_scd_model_portfolios_mapping m
     on m.trading_portfolio_code = t.trading_portfolio_code
     and m.business_date = t.business_date

 and trade_id is not null

                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id

                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId

                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId

                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL

            LEFT JOIN

                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 06 and 07
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 06:35:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

       spi.investmentstructurelevel3                          AS "Investment Structure Level 03",
       spi.investmentstructurelevel4                          AS "Investment Structure Level 04",
       --   herbi.scd_security_id                                  AS "CPPIB Security ID - Current",
       herbi.abor_security_number                             AS "Security No. - Current",
       herbi.abor_security_name                               AS "Security Name - Current",
       coalesce(asec.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code,
                             herbi.cur_exp)                   AS "Currency of Exposure Code - Current",
       coalesce(asec.cppib_country_of_exposure_code,'NAP')    as "Country of Exposure Code - Current",
       CASE WHEN herbi.abor_security_type_name = 'Normal Cash Bucket'
              THEN herbi.Clean_value_quotation_currency
              ELSE herbi.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency
       END AS "Balance Cost Value QC",
       herbi.clean_value_portfolio_currency                   AS "Clean Value PC",
       CASE WHEN herbi.abor_security_type_name = 'Normal Cash Bucket'
              THEN herbi.dirty_value_portfolio_currency
              ELSE herbi.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency
       END AS "Total Market Value PC",

       herbi.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS "Fx Rate QC/PC"
